title: Feel The AGI
author: SavePlanetNow
selftext:
I'm on parental leave, so I tried the new coding models while the baby sleeps. Pretty impressed: I came back and the AI had made stuff. I guess AI did pretty much everything :) (Claude for the game and movie, Suno for the song.) 

  
Models: Claude 5.5 and Suno 6-mini 

Concept: me 

  
It took about a three days to create (while spending most time with my son). Mostly waiting for Claude to finish up, or some rendering on my very slow laptop. 



It's a card game where AI labs race to get rich before the Singularity. It's pretty rough, but I wanted to show it to someone.



Play: [https://feeltheagi.games](https://feeltheagi.games)

Movie: [https://youtu.be/uVIqx8CXByo](https://youtu.be/uVIqx8CXByo)

  
It was also AI that proposed I post it in this group. I had never heard about it before, but the AI seem to think this was the best fit on the internet :) 



Post how much money you made. It's all about the money.

comments.author: Schwolop
comments.body: I enjoyed the silly song. I tried the game but honestly gave up pretty quick. You need a bit more explanation of the player's aim. Like a guided tutorial that plays out the first turn and explains the options a bit more. As far as I can tell everything worked, but an issue with board games like this is that when you have 500+ cards players just shrug and can't decide what to play because the impact (benefits and costs) is opaque to them. I'd slow things down a bit too; have an animation after playing a card that \*shows\* the particular numbers going up as a result so players get that dawning realisation that their choices do matter.
